html:
The Summer Olympic Games held in Beijing in August 2008, the first Olympics in China. They opened at 8 pm on 8 August 2008, as eight is a lucky number.

The main venue was the Beijing National Stadium, called the Bird's Nest for its lattice of steel, designed by Herzog and de Meuron with the artist Ai Weiwei. The film director Zhang Yimou staged an opening ceremony with thousands of drummers that showed off Chinese history and inventions. China won the most gold medals. Michael Phelps won eight golds in swimming and Usain Bolt broke sprint records.

The games were a show of China's rise after three decades of reform and opening. They also drew protests over Tibet during the torch relay and criticism of forced evictions and censorship. Three months earlier the Sichuan earthquake had killed some 70,000 people. Beijing hosted the Winter Olympics in 2022, the first city to hold both.
sum: The Summer Olympic Games held in Beijing in August 2008, the first Olympics in China. They opened at 8 pm on 8 August 2008, as eight is a lucky number.
